sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 420. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies stun.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 60 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 14000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 14000
